name: period
description: Day (YYYY-MM-DD) or month (YYYY-MM) that was loaded.

name: partition_id
description: Partition replaced: YYYYMMDD or YYYYMM (`partition` is a reserved word in BigQuery SQL).

name: expected_rows
description: Rows the lake manifest says the period holds (counted at the source).

name: loaded_rows
description: Rows the BigQuery load job wrote.

name: manifest_extracted_at
description: When the period was extracted from the source.
